0022600096.text: The Timberwolves have yet to play a 2026-27 game, while the Orlando Magic are 0-1 after a home loss, sitting 5th in the Southeast, one game back, and 13th in the East. Minnesota is missing Donte DiVincenzo, who is out with an Achilles injury that required surgery, and Orlando is without Anthony Black (ankle sprain), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring). The teams have not met yet this season, and the Timberwolves lost both matchups in 2025-26, most recently 132-120 in Orlando on April 8, 2026.
